output.summary: Adds a POST /orders feature across layers: route registration, a handler, a service that validates quantity, and an in-memory storage layer. A test covers createOrder. Check that the layers agree on the order shape and that validation is enough.

groups.title: POST /orders route and handler
groups.description: registerRoutes wires postOrder to POST /orders, and postOrder casts the body and calls createOrder. Check that the unvalidated body cast is acceptable.

groups.title: createOrder service
groups.description: createOrder rejects quantities below 1 and delegates to insertOrder. Check that sku and non-integer quantities need no validation.

groups.title: In-memory order storage
groups.description: Adds the OrderRow type and insertOrder, which assigns ids from an in-memory array. Check that id assignment and non-persistence are intended.

groups.title: createOrder test
groups.description: One test checks that the first created order gets id 1. It does not cover the quantity validation or the route.
